fact: The Stanford Encyclopedia says the 1900 problem was followed by a sketch of a consistency proof in the Heidelberg talk (1905), and that Hilbert's own proposal was presented in three Hamburg talks of summer 1921 (published 1922); Wikipedia dates the programme to the early 1920s, so the 1905 lecture is better classed as a precursor and the first_statement as 1922.

note: Read the SEP entry and Wikipedia page; the lecture text itself was not read, so 1905 as precursor rests on the two secondary accounts.
